page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Three footnotes below the text, one for each mark (d), (e), (f). Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: nutensem, qui ad Archiepiscopatum Rhe-mensem translatus fuerat, deinde {d} clarissimum virum Dominum deMarca, nuperrimè ad Episcopatum Conseranensiũ-à Rege Christianissimo designatum, antea in Parlamento Palensi Præsidem, cujus summam eruditionem & ingenium laudans, de illius libro, cui nomen fe-cerat de Concordia Sacerdotii & Regni ita loquitur : materia ubique fere, sed in Gallia potissimum anceps, lubrica & diffi-cilis, aitqve in confesso esse apud omnes hujus rei peritos, neminem è foro scrip-toremabhinc annos 120. Ecclesiasticæ autoritati magis favisse. Interea {e} Cardinalis Barberinus Morini sui haud im-memor, eum beneficio Ecclesiastico do-nare voluit, sed illud acceptare se non posse testatus est Morinus, tam ob residentiæ obligationem quàm quòd in ea Regione, ubi situm erat beneficium istud, bella undiqve circunstreperent. Commendavit etiam {f} Morinus Cardinali Francisco Barberino per literas Feroni-

page.notes: Printed footnote marks (d), (e), (f) are in parentheses in the text and in the notes; I have given them as {d}, {e}, {f}. Small ornament after "circunstreperent" was read as a full stop. "Conseranensiũ" uses a tilde over u as printed; the hyphen and word end are clear. Word "favisse" is printed with a long-s form; transcribed as "favisse" in the text. Lines "nutensem" and "Feroni-" are a fragment and a word broken across the page end; the first paragraph continues from the previous page.
